question: Should ai& be accepted into CodexBar's core provider catalog once successful funded-account behavior is demonstrated?
rationale: The implementation follows the current provider architecture, but admitting another service to the maintained core catalog requires repository-owner judgment about scope and long-term support.

options.title: Accept after funded proof
options.body: Approve the provider direction conditionally and merge only after a redacted successful spend retrieval and rendering artifact is added.

options.title: Decline core integration
options.body: Close the PR if ai& does not meet the desired adoption, maintenance, or provider-fit threshold for the core catalog.

recommendation.title: Accept after funded proof
recommendation.body: Approve the provider direction conditionally and merge only after a redacted successful spend retrieval and rendering artifact is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available authority for expanding the maintained provider catalog.
